name: 24502 · Lynchburg, VA
findings: ZIP 24502 (Lynchburg) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24502 (Lynchburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24502 (Lynchburg) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
